archived_correlation_block.key_defect: the key 'M(0.01)' holds pearsonr(mass_0.05, top-1), i.e. the M(0.01) measurement was never made; the M(0.05) entry duplicates it bit-for-bit

implied_margin_bounds.logic: M(eps) = P(margin <= 2 eps). M(eps) = 1 implies min_i margin_i <= 2 eps; M(eps) < 1 implies min_i margin_i > 2 eps. A bracket on the smallest margin of each arm follows

control.interpretation: the grid must contain an eps below eps* = min_i margin_i / 2 for the row to leave saturation; the archived grids start at 0.02, which is above every archived row's eps* bound

adapted.interpretation: the grid must contain an eps below eps* = min_i margin_i / 2 for the row to leave saturation; the archived grids start at 0.02, which is above every archived row's eps* bound

conclusion.headline: the coarse grid, not the statistic, produced the saturation: with eps extended down to 0.001 every one of the 32 archived surgery rows leaves M = 1, and the pooled correlation with top-1 reaches -0.981 (control) / -0.900 (adapted), i.e. the certificate is informative at its domain's own resolution
conclusion.second_finding: the correlation is not robust to eps: it falls monotonically (-0.981 -> -0.327 control; -0.900 -> -0.282 adapted as eps goes 0.001 -> 0.02) and it does not hold within every domain at the same eps - on the marine-optical control the within-domain correlation is weak and sign-flipping (-0.389 at eps=0.001, +0.817 at eps=0.005)
conclusion.third_finding: a domain-relative resolution does make the four domains mutually consistent, but the statistic is then too smooth to carry a within-domain health threshold: one constant c with eps = c * median_i margin_i gives within-domain r in [-1.000, -0.872] at c = 0.01-0.02 in all four domains, yet the balanced-accuracy transfer across domains stays at 0.50
conclusion.not_supported: a single absolute epsilon portable across the marine/sonar/adapted domains, and any threshold on M that transfers across domains or encoders (best cross-domain balanced accuracy 0.55; chance 0.50)
conclusion.reproducibility: the recomputation reproduces every archived eps in {0.02, 0.05, 0.10} value exactly (max |diff| = 0.0 over 24 rows x 3 eps)
